note: Ground-truth catalog for the T1-05 node-type vocabulary compliance check. The membership validator (diagram_checks._node_type_checks) accepts any token in `types` (name or alias) or `styling_classes`; a token outside the catalog is flagged with a fuzzy-match suggestion. `unknown`/`other` are first-class passing members so typing is never coerced. Aliases fold the incumbent Mermaid classDef names + the D2 POC class names onto the same permissive type set.
